blocks.text: 🪝 CBDT Issues Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF) Compliance Rules. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: CARF Alignment: Aligns Indian crypto exchange reporting with OECD global framework.
Reporting Scope: RCASPs must collect tax residency and TIN details for annual submission.
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on global publishing body, India ranking/score movement, top-ranked country, and underlying evaluation indicators.
